EEE-Bench: A Comprehensive Multimodal Electrical And Electronics Engineering Benchmark
	


	
		
		Introduction:
	

EEE-Bench is a multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate the practical engineering capabilities of large multimodal models (LMMs), using electrical and electronics engineering (EEE) as the domain focus.
